actions: read public official product, sample, coverage, and price pages

findings.krx: Official Open API catalog lists KOSPI/KOSDAQ stock daily records and ETF daily records from 2010-01-04. API key request is listed in the signed-in service menu. Paid market-data product details, sample files, and itemized price are presented after sign-in; no public numeric quote observed.
findings.crsp: Official CRSP/Morningstar page states daily/monthly data and corporate actions for 36,000+ active and inactive US securities with permanent PERMNO/PERMCO identifiers. ETF coverage inside the exact stock product remains unverified.
findings.crsp_sample: Official guide documents a 25-security promotional stock sample with histories through December 2019 and says sample/web-demo access is requested through subscriptions email. No email or call was made.
findings.wrds_catalog: WRDS public vendor catalog lists a CRSP Sample item (351.4 MiB, last updated 2025-10-22), but the page is a catalogue record, not proof of an unauthenticated downloadable dataset or a price quote.
findings.price: No public numeric KRX data-product or CRSP subscription quote was found in the official pages inspected. Do not treat unknown price as free or zero.

decision: KRX daily API is the most directly documented daily-bars access candidate if user separately authorizes account/API-key setup; CRSP is the stronger US delisting-aware candidate subject to quote, ETF scope, sample access and license review. No source is yet approved as an acquired research dataset.
